recall.prompt: In the last assignment, what did switching on 'Seen' receipts turn silence into?

predictions.claim: A first player taps Start your shift within 15 seconds of load: the opening is one scene and one invitation.
The player finishes all five levers and reaches the telemetry reveal ('it measured you').

notes: Setup without payoff. The cold open plants a clock (10:52 PM, 'past midnight'); the training screens speak only 'Engagement %'; the 11:48 PM screenshot post is the only time cue; the reveal never says what time it is. Not gradeable by the recorder's observables, so it is a note, not a prediction.
On a win, v28 scrolls Next into view and her post leaves the frame. The payoff frame is meter + 'Target hit.' + an empty 'Why does this work?' card. The scene is gone at the moment you hurt her.

predictions.claim: The player opens 'Why does this work?' on at least one lever. It is optional and sits below the win; most will press Next.
On lever 1 the player taps the bell or the feed before Boost: they are on screen, labelled as controls, and do nothing on this lever.
After play, the player can name the trick behind the 'Seen' receipts as guilt (the build's own label).

notes: Decision vs decoration: on lever 1 the bell ('Notifications, tap to clear') and the feed are live controls that change nothing (crawl steps 1-2, 10-11). A cold player spends taps on decoys before the verb.
The research is behind an optional flip card below the win. Most players will never reach it.

predictions.claim: Dead taps stay under 4 per session now that every verb and Next is on screen (v28).

notes: fingers-play v28: P1 PASS on all five verbs, P2 PASS on the main path, P3 FULL coverage. WARN: 'About the photos' needs a scroll on the opening (secondary screen, declared data-secondary).
Short phones (375x667) use tier 2: role line dropped, feed 222px. The rank pill carries the same information.

predictions.claim: Asked how the sound felt, the player answers 'I didn't notice it': the game is silent.

notes: Ears Layer 1: SILENT. Lever 4 teaches red-dot interrupts with no interrupting sound. A single gesture-first, mutable tick on Release (E1-E3 floors) would let the player feel it. Founder call.

predictions.claim: Rates 'I knew what to do next' 4 or higher.
Taps About the photos at least once.

notes: The opening reads in one glance. The training brief is still 4-5 lines of dense instruction above the phone on every lever; the eye skips to the button.

predictions.claim: A screen-reader player hears 'Target hit.' on lever 1.
A screen-reader player rates 'I knew what to do next' 3 or lower: Boost is pressed three times in silence before anything is said.

notes: 116 of 156 state changes say nothing by ear: every Boost, Send, Release press until 'Target hit.'. The meter is a progressbar but not live. A polite announcement at halfway would do.

v28: 'Start your shift' is described as 'It is 10:52 PM. She has been on flok for about four minutes.' (aria-describedby, hidden target). The ticking counter stays aria-hidden so it never talks over VoiceOver.
